note: Normalize synonymous observed features only. Story settings are descriptions, not algorithm triggers. Unknown features remain available and require explanation; aliases do not infer identity, gender or unobserved motion.

definitions.speech: Actual identifiable dialogue, monologue, narration or spoken CTA; ASR blank alone is not absence.
definitions.multi_character_dialogue: At least two actual speaking roles supported by source audio/context; shot count or ASR segments is not speaker count.
definitions.short_drama: Observed dramatic dialogue/narrative, not inferred only from family/hospital/school labels.
definitions.short_utterance: A brief actual reply/interjection requiring independent coverage; no universal duration threshold.
definitions.long_speech: An actual turn whose translated duration strains its observed source window.
definitions.overlapping_speech: Audible simultaneous turns, not merely adjacent ASR segments.
definitions.static_text_surface: Stable observed surface/container, separately protect dynamic fingers/numbers/icons.
definitions.animated_text: Text itself changes position/scale/rotation/opacity/shape, not camera motion alone.
definitions.foreground_occlusion: Actual object passes in front of text/repair area and needs time-dependent layering.
definitions.publisher_watermark: Observed publisher watermark or a confirmed matching endcard wordmark/logo; static or moving. Identity is an Agent observation, not a filename guess.
definitions.moving_watermark: Observed publisher mark changes position/rotation or enters/leaves frame.
definitions.speech_captions: Text actually representing spoken content, distinct from independent title/UI.
definitions.artistic_typography: Observed decorative, textured, outlined or expressive letterforms requiring style judgment, not any large font.
definitions.filmed_phone_ui: A physical phone screen seen in the source scene, including its perspective and foreground interaction.
definitions.surface_typography: Target text must follow an observed surface's geometry, texture, transparency or motion instead of a plain screen overlay.
definitions.multiple_shots: Observed cuts or scene changes; this alone does not prove animated text or multiple speakers.
definitions.sung_background_music: Actual sung musical material whose retention/replacement needs a role decision, separate from spoken dialogue.
definitions.multilingual_batch: The real user request contains multiple target locales; never increases source count or request credit allowance.
definitions.repeated_character: Evidence links the same speaking role across turns/shots; keep its identity and voice stable.
definitions.onscreen_text: Actual non-preserved onscreen text instances; includes captions, does not establish text-led type.
definitions.audio_led: Agent observed core information is carried primarily by intelligible speech; all onscreen copy still covered.
definitions.onscreen_text_led: Agent observed core information in independent onscreen copy; all narration/dialogue still translated.
definitions.mixed: Agent observed speech and independent onscreen copy each carry essential information; subtitles alone do not establish mixed type.
